subject.title: fix(openrouter): use dedicated /api/v1/images endpoint for image generation

question: Should OpenClaw accept `endpointPath` as the public Plugin SDK seam for flat OpenAI-compatible image endpoints in this PR?
rationale: The option is additive and tested, but it is exported through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/image-generation`, so this becomes a third-party plugin contract rather than an OpenRouter-only implementation detail.

options.title: Accept endpointPath and align docs
options.body: Keep the shared factory design, update the remaining image-generation tool guide, and treat `endpointPath` as the supported flat-endpoint SDK seam.

options.title: Keep endpoint handling local
options.body: Remove the public option and implement OpenRouter's flat `/images` URL handling inside the OpenRouter provider if maintainers do not want to expand the SDK yet.

options.title: Fold into the broader model PR
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the broader OpenRouter model and compatibility strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97505.

recommendation.title: Accept endpointPath and align docs
recommendation.body: Keep the shared factory design, update the remaining image-generation tool guide, and treat `endpointPath` as the supported flat-endpoint SDK seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the shared image helper and Plugin SDK export path where the strongest history signal is steipete's prior work.
